title: codemie-gitops repository configuration
description: Closed non-secret schema for .codemie/config.yaml. Version: v25 (SEC-001/SEC-002 remediation).

url.description: CodeMie API base URL (ValidatedUrl). HTTPS required for non-loopback hosts; HTTP is accepted at schema level for loopback endpoints and enforced at runtime. No userinfo, no fragment, no control characters.

auth_url.description: Keycloak token endpoint (ValidatedUrl). HTTPS only — no HTTP exception for the identity provider. No userinfo, no fragment, no control characters.

project.description: Default project name. Must not contain control characters or bidi formatting codes.
